बॉलीवुड स्टार अहान शेट्टी अब एक बिल्कुल नए अवतार में धमाका करने के लिए तैयार हैं! 🎬🔥

Border 2 की सफलता के बाद, Ahan Shetty अपनी अगली फिल्म Sanki की शूटिंग शुरू करने जा रहे हैं। इस रोमांटिक एक्शन एंटरटेनर फिल्म का शूटिंग शेड्यूल 30 October से Bhopal में शुरू हो रहा है।

इस फिल्म के डायरेक्टर Rustom और Mission Raniganj बनाने वाले Tinu Suresh Desai हैं, जो अपनी क्रू के साथ Bhopal पहुंचकर फाइनल तैयारियां कर रहे हैं। Gyanendra Vasudev द्वारा लिखी गई इस फिल्म में एक गहरी लव स्टोरी के साथ-साथ ज़बरदस्त एक्शन भी देखने को मिलेगा।

मेकर्स ने अभी कहानी का सस्पेंस बरकरार रखा है। यह फिल्म 2027 की पहली छमाही में सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज़ होगी, जिसे We The People, Roaring River Productions और Pals & Peers Entertainment मिलकर बैक कर रहे हैं। इसके अलावा Ahan आने वाले समय में Vikram Bhatt की 1920 Cold Winter में भी नजर आएंगे। 💥✨

क्या आप Ahan Shetty को इस नई रोमांटिक एक्शन फिल्म में देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय ज़रूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.text:
After Border 2, the actor is set to return to the sets with a love story packed with emotions and raw action.
After the success of Border 2 , Ahan Shetty is gearing up for his next project, Sanki . The actor is set to begin shooting for the film in Bhopal on October 30, with filmmaker Tinu Suresh Desai, known for directing Rustom and Mission Raniganj , at the helm. Positioned as a romantic action entertainer, the film is expected to combine an intense love story with emotional drama and high-octane action.
Written by Gyanendra Vasudev, Sanki will explore a love story at its core while incorporating raw and explosive action. The makers have kept the subject and storyline under wraps for now, with plans to reveal further details in due course. The film is scheduled to arrive in theatres in the first half of 2027.
Director Tinu Suresh Desai has already reached Bhopal with a large crew and is overseeing the final preparations ahead of the shoot. The production is expected to begin on October 30, marking Ahan’s next on-set outing following his appearance in Border 2 .
Following the response to Border 2 , Ahan has reportedly been selective about his next projects. Sanki will be among his upcoming releases, followed by Vikram Bhatt’s 1920 Cold Winter . The actor is also expected to begin work on a couple of additional projects in 2027.
The film is backed by We The People, Roaring River Productions and Pals & Peers Entertainment. The project marks another step in Ahan’s career as he looks to build on the attention generated by his recent big-screen outing.
While the makers have not disclosed further details about the characters or the plot, the combination of romance, emotional conflict and action is expected to form the film’s central appeal. With the shooting schedule beginning in Bhopal, the production is now moving towards its next phase.
Sanki is slated for a theatrical release in the first half of 2027. Further details about the film, including its storyline and additional cast members, are expected to be announced by the makers in the coming months.
